entries.formal_claim: Equal-information ternary storage can have lower total physical cost than binary storage under stated device and overhead assumptions.

earliest_identified_source.status: original invention date unknown; historical PDF unavailable

entries.baseline: Optimally packed binary representation of the same M states; same reliability, access and I/O requirements.
assumptions: C2 and C3 have the same physical cost unit
Include sensing, ECC, control and conversion rather than treating grouping as a physical element
entries.measurement: Exact ceil(log_b M) counts and sensitivity over measured device costs; area/energy/latency reported separately.
entries.falsifier: No cost reduction over matched binary anywhere in the preregistered plausible parameter region, or reduction vanishes with overhead.
entries.result: D: ideal threshold derived; M=256 and C3/C2=1.5 gives ternary cost 9 vs binary 8. B: current RTL uses two binary bits per trit and supplies no measured three-state-device advantage.
entries.confidence: High for exact arithmetic/source facts; physical advantage open.
entries.next_action: Use storage_boundary.py and selected factorial model; require independent device data before physical claims.

entries.formal_claim: Balanced ternary can improve a specified signed arithmetic or rounding task at equal semantics and cost accounting.
entries.baseline: Exact integer oracle, competitive binary signed arithmetic and a correct ternary candidate.
assumptions: Candidate must be closed over its advertised digit set
Representable outputs only; overflow rules explicit
entries.measurement: Correctness first; then matched carry/depth/work/latency or rounding-error metrics.
entries.falsifier: Candidate fails exact arithmetic, or no advantage survives equivalent optimized binary and conversion costs.
entries.result: A: isolated current CWEB routines fail balanced positional semantics: addition 422/547; multiplication 140/201; negation 0/27 failures. This rejects these routines as evidence, not balanced ternary mathematics. Multiplication is documented as componentwise; the oracle failure rules it out for positional-integer claims, not for a separately specified vector algebra.
entries.confidence: High for isolated reproduction; complete Hanoi integration untested.
entries.next_action: Preserve failures; specify domain and correct oracle before any performance comparison; do not rewrite Hanoi.

entries.formal_claim: Grouping four trits as base-81 can provide a workload-specific interface or execution benefit beyond equivalent binary packing.
entries.baseline: Ungrouped ternary, binary bit-packed and binary limb representations with equal value domains.
assumptions: 81=3^4 is grouping, not a free 81-level device
Indexing, padding, decode and conversion charged
entries.measurement: Storage bytes and end-to-end operation cost with grouping ablation.
entries.falsifier: A matched packed-binary implementation removes the apparent benefit or grouping overhead dominates.
entries.result: D: four-trit grouping established. B: grouped numeric/data surfaces exist; no grouping-specific performance advantage reproduced in this session.
entries.next_action: Keep mathematical grouping distinct from kernel speed and physical storage; isolate grouping in a later ablation.

entries.formal_claim: An explicitly defined adaptive ternary representation policy can beat fixed ternary and an equally capable adaptive binary policy on a specified workload.
entries.baseline: Fixed binary, adaptive binary, fixed ternary, adaptive ternary; identical domains, predictor information and conversion accounting.
assumptions: Original 81/243/729 labels do not establish bit widths or equivalent domains
Entropy/depth heuristic and promotion logic are distinct source mechanisms
Modern Tier0..Tier6 resource limits are not proof of the historical scheduler
entries.measurement: Factorial radix/adaptation contrasts; storage, selection, switching and conversion reported separately before any dimensionally valid aggregate model.
entries.falsifier: No advantage over adaptive binary, effect is equally explained by adaptation, or correctness/transition costs remove it.
entries.result: B: scheduler thresholds >40/>100 and AI substring; promotion uses enum 0/1/2 with depth>10/tensor trigger. No verified mapping from tier_mode to mode or equivalent semantic domains; original H04 remains under-specified.
entries.confidence: High for source facts; optimization/integration unproven.
entries.next_action: Select H04-R01 capacity-trace discriminator as a declared refinement, not a reconstruction of working Hanoi semantics.

entries.formal_claim: A specified three-state primitive can reduce circuit or system cost against an equivalent Boolean implementation.
entries.baseline: Boolean synthesis for exactly the same function, I/O states, throughput and reliability.
assumptions: A two-bit binary comparator can encode three outcomes
Saturating single-trit ADD differs from positional multi-trit addition
entries.measurement: Gate count/depth, mapped area/energy and input/output conversion under a common process.
entries.falsifier: Equivalent Boolean synthesis matches or beats claimed cost, or semantics differ.
entries.result: B: hardware repo implements eight operations over signed two-bit trit signals; CMP3 handler in the Hanoi table is null. No physical or synthesis comparison reproduced.
entries.confidence: Source inspection only; architectural benefit open.
entries.next_action: Formalize one operation truth table before any new ISA or hardware extension.

entries.formal_claim: Ternary weights or activations can improve accuracy-constrained inference versus equally optimized binary low-bit alternatives.

earliest_identified_source.earliest_invention: not established from unavailable historical records

entries.baseline: Matched INT8/low-bit kernels and models at equal task accuracy, bandwidth and batching.
assumptions: README speedups are claims, not independent observations
Separate compression, arithmetic, bandwidth and accuracy effects
entries.measurement: Task accuracy, memory footprint and measured latency/energy with matched kernels and conversion.
entries.falsifier: Equivalent optimized baseline removes speed/size advantage at equal accuracy.
entries.result: B: implementations and C: prior reports exist. No inference benchmark, model accuracy or device energy independently reproduced here.
entries.next_action: Audit existing artifact/model provenance before designing a bounded kernel/model experiment.

entries.formal_claim: Representation-independent governed execution can improve a defined auditability property.
entries.baseline: Conventional runtime plus explicit authorization/evidence boundary; equal threat model and host trust.
assumptions: Authorization, evidence integrity, factual validity and consent are different
No inference-security or malicious-host claims from simulated dispatch
entries.measurement: Replay/tamper/revocation and pre-side-effect denial with trustworthy test execution.
entries.falsifier: Conventional baseline meets the same defined property at lower cost, or evidence/authorization bypass is reproduced.
entries.result: Separate engineering track. PRs #565/#566 remain open/draft: both CodeQL pass, required quality gate fails. Existing source/test reports are not a new independent security certification here.
entries.confidence: Current PR metadata checked; prior security tests not rerun in this session.
entries.next_action: Maintain the bounded CI/security investigation separately; Protocol 001 remains NOT READY.
